Name: The Anything Keg
Author: Eeveereest
Description:
Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/65792556]moyaofthemist[/url]﻿ for the sprite work and helping me put this together.
Adds a keg, in which almost every material in Stardew Valley can be turned into Wine.
EVEN WINE CAN BE TURNED INTO WINE, RESULTING IN A WINE WINE XD.
Requires Custom Farming Redux (CFR)

Please do let me know if you found an Item that you cannot put in the keg.
Thank you!

The next version will be a SMAPI mod.
Installing The anything keg version 2+ will require the deletion of anything below version two

When updating from Version 1.0.0,
Please delete the original folder before starting Stardew Valley
(Anything Keg)

*Disclaimer*
I take no responsibility for the "Cheatyness" of this mod.
